cards.note: Story; also to tell, chat about: «Dia cerita pengalamannya.» = He told (us) about his experience.
cards.note_ja: 話、物語。「話す」の意味でも：«Dia cerita pengalamannya.»＝彼は自分の経験を話した。

cards.note: Interest: «Encik ada minat lain?» = Do you have other interests? Root of «berminat» (Ch10).
cards.note_ja: 興味、関心：«Encik ada minat lain?»＝ほかに趣味はありますか。«berminat»（第10課）の語根。

cards.note: To watch (a film, a match): «tonton filem». Bare root, as in speech.
cards.note_ja: （映画や試合を）見る：«tonton filem»。会話どおりの語根の形。

cards.note: To change (something): «ubah warna bilik» = change the colour of the room. Compare «berubah» (to change by itself).
cards.note_ja: （何かを）変える：«ubah warna bilik»＝部屋の色を変える。«berubah»（自然に変わる）と比べて。

cards.gloss_ja: いる、ある（あらたまった言い方）
cards.note: ber- + ada (Ch2): to be (in a place), to be present: «Semua jiran berada di ruang tamu.»
cards.note_ja: ber- + ada（第2課）：（ある場所に）いる、ある：«Semua jiran berada di ruang tamu.»

cards.note: ber- + bincang (Ch10 ⚡): to discuss, talk something over: «berbincang dengan pengurus».
cards.note_ja: ber- + bincang（第10課⚡）：話し合う：«berbincang dengan pengurus»。

cards.note: ber- + kali (Ch3), said twice: many times over, again and again.
cards.note_ja: ber- + kali（第3課）を2回：何度も何度も。

cards.note: ber- + sebelah (Ch7) + -an: next to each other: «Rumah kami bersebelahan.» = Our houses are next to each other.
cards.note_ja: ber- + sebelah（第7課）+ -an：隣り合った：«Rumah kami bersebelahan.»＝うちは隣同士です。

cards.note: ber- + tulis (Ch4): written, in writing: «jawapan bertulis» = a written answer.
cards.note_ja: ber- + tulis（第4課）：書かれた、書面の：«jawapan bertulis»＝書面の答え。

cards.note: ber- + ubah (Ch10 ⚡): to change (by itself): «Cuaca cepat berubah.» = The weather changes quickly.
cards.note_ja: ber- + ubah（第10課⚡）：（自然に）変わる：«Cuaca cepat berubah.»＝天気がすぐ変わる。

cards.note: ber- + ulang: to repeat, happen again: «Masalah ini berulang.» = This keeps happening.
cards.note_ja: ber- + ulang：くり返す、再び起こる。

cards.note: Field (of work or study): «bidang perniagaan» = the business field.
cards.note_ja: 分野：«bidang perniagaan»＝ビジネスの分野。

cards.note: To discuss (root of «berbincang»).
cards.note_ja: 話し合う（«berbincang» の語根）。

cards.gloss_ja: 研究する（«ulang kaji» 復習する）
cards.note: To study, look into. «ulang kaji» = to revise (for an exam). Root of «kajian».
cards.note_ja: 調べる、研究する。«ulang kaji»＝（試験の）復習をする。«kajian» の語根。

cards.note: kaji (Ch10 ⚡) + -an: a study, research: «buat kajian» = do research.
cards.note_ja: kaji（第10課⚡）+ -an：研究、調査：«buat kajian»＝研究する。

cards.note: ke- + lemah + -an: weakness, weak point: «Kelemahan saya: saya suka tidur!»
cards.note_ja: ke- + lemah + -an：弱点：«Kelemahan saya: saya suka tidur!»＝私の弱点は寝るのが好きなこと！

cards.note: Factory: «kilang kereta» = a car factory.
cards.note_ja: 工場：«kilang kereta»＝自動車工場。

cards.note: Business (the field or the activity), taught as a whole word. «berniaga» (Ch10) = to do business.
cards.note_ja: ビジネス、商売（一語として学ぶ）。«berniaga»（第10課）＝商売をする。

cards.note: To skip (class, school or work), play truant: «ponteng kelas».
cards.note_ja: （授業や仕事を）さぼる：«ponteng kelas»。

cards.note: se- + rumah (Ch2): (in) the same house: «kawan serumah» = housemate.
cards.note_ja: se- + rumah（第2課）：同じ家の：«kawan serumah»＝ルームメイト、同居人。

cards.note: Era, period, time: «zaman sekolah» = school days, «zaman dulu» = the old days.
cards.note_ja: 時代：«zaman sekolah»＝学生時代、«zaman dulu»＝昔。

frames.example: Kami berbincang dengan pengurus setiap hari Isnin.
frames.meaning_en: We have a discussion with the manager every Monday.
frames.meaning_ja: 毎週月曜日にマネージャーと話し合います。

frames.example: Kawan serumah saya berasal dari Jepun.
frames.meaning_ja: ルームメイトは日本出身です。

frames.example: Cuaca di pulau ini cepat berubah.
frames.meaning_en: The weather on this island changes quickly.
frames.meaning_ja: この島の天気はすぐ変わります。

frames.example: Saya mahu ubah warna bilik saya.
frames.meaning_en: I want to change the colour of my room.
frames.meaning_ja: 部屋の色を変えたいです。

frames.example: Sila hantar jawapan bertulis sebelum hari Jumaat.
frames.meaning_en: Please send a written answer before Friday.
frames.meaning_ja: 金曜日までに書面で回答を送ってください。

frames.meaning_en: He told us about his experience again and again.
frames.meaning_ja: 彼は自分の経験を何度も何度も話しました。

scenario.title_ja: 日曜日、シティさんの家で

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Selamat datang, Encik Tanaka! Semua jiran berada di ruang tamu.
lines.en: Welcome, Mr Tanaka! All the neighbours are in the living room.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Terima kasih, Puan. Rumah Puan bersebelahan dengan rumah saya, bukan?
lines.en: Thank you. Your house is right next to mine, isn't it?
choices: Terima kasih, Puan. Rumah Puan berenang di kolam renang, bukan?
Maaf, Puan. Saya ponteng hari ini.
choices_en: Thank you. Your house swims in the pool, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Betul! Encik sudah lama berada di Malaysia?
lines.en: That's right! Have you been in Malaysia long?

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Baru dua tahun. Sebelum itu saya bekerja di sebuah kilang di Osaka.
lines.en: Only two years. Before that I worked at a factory in Osaka.
choices: Sudah lama. Saya berumur dua tahun.
Baru dua tahun. Saya berasal dari kilang.
choices_en: A long time. I'm two years old.
Only two years. I come from a factory.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Kilang kereta. Sekarang saya bekerja dalam bidang perniagaan.
lines.en: A car factory. Now I work in business.

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.en: Do you have any other interests?

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Ya, saya suka tonton filem lama. Filem zaman dulu sangat bagus.
lines.en: Yes, I like watching old films. Films from the old days are very good.
choices: Ya, saya suka tonton kilang kereta.
choices_en: Yes, I like watching car factories.

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Anak saya buat kajian di universiti, dalam bidang muzik.
lines.en: My child does research at university, in music.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Bagus! Saya pula selalu ponteng kelas pada zaman sekolah dulu.
lines.en: Great! Me, I was always skipping class back in my school days.
choices: Bagus! Anak Puan berumur dua tahun?
Bagus! Saya tidak pernah tonton filem.
choices_en: Great! Is your child two years old?
Great! I've never watched a film.

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Wah! Zaman sudah berubah, Encik. Sekarang Encik bekerja setiap hari.
lines.en: Well! Times have changed. Now you work every day.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Betul. Tetapi kelemahan saya tidak berubah: saya suka tidur!
lines.en: True. But my weakness hasn't changed: I love sleeping!
choices: Betul. Tetapi saya tidak pernah tidur!

lines.speaker: Puan Siti
lines.ms: Mari kita makan dulu. Kek ini dari kedai saya.
lines.en: Come, let's eat first. This cake is from my shop.
